item.title: MDM’s Narwhal cables mark Ireland’s bid to become a transatlantic gateway
item.summary: Marine survey work is now under way off County Galway, as Irish subsea developer MDM begins fieldwork for Narwhal 1 and Narwhal 2, twin transatlantic cable systems that would connect Ireland directly to the US east coast. The post MDM’s Narwhal cables mark Ireland’s bid to become a transatlantic gateway appeared first on Capacity .
